decision.summary: NO_ACTION: reconciliation is broken after the expired 76k DIP position disappeared without a matching closure record, so no new daily entry is valid.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. The hard blocker this cycle is reconciliation: `reconciliation.ok` is false and the context explicitly reports `missing closure record for will-bitcoin-dip-to-76k-on-may-19:Yes`. Under the playbook, that makes `NO_ACTION` the only valid opening decision until state is repaired. There are no live positions to close or reduce now, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and cash is back to 7.321958 with open_value 0. The May 20 daily board is forming and Binance has rebounded to around 77197, but the latest Beecthor thesis is also stale now and, in any case, the reconciliation gate already forbids fresh exposure this cycle.
